mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_provider WHERE name = #{name} AND id <> #{exceptId})
INSERT INTO model_provider (name, base_url, api_key_cipher, api_key_last4) VALUES (#{name}, #{baseUrl}, #{apiKeyCipher}, #{apiKeyLast4}) RETURNING id
SELECT purpose, provider_id, model, updated_by_name, updated_at FROM model_purpose WHERE purpose = #{purpose}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_purpose (purpose, provider_id, model, updated_by_name, updated_at) VALUES (#{purpose}, #{providerId}, #{model}, #{updatedByName}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (purpose) DO UPDATE SET provider_id = EXCLUDED.provider_id, model = EXCLUDED.model, updated_by_name = EXCLUDED.updated_by_name, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at

INSERT INTO model_change (purpose, before_provider_name, before_model, after_provider_id, after_provider_name, after_model, changed_by, changed_by_name, changed_at, restored_from) VALUES (#{purpose}, #{beforeProviderName}, #{beforeModel}, #{afterProviderId}, #{afterProviderName}, #{afterModel}, #{changedBy}, #{changedByName}, #{changedAt}, #{restoredFrom})
